3. A fixed payment buys less as prices rise, so its real value erodes. A payment that rises each year can hold up better against inflation. The caption in frame 4, "how much smaller: not modeled," says the animation doesn't calculate how much buying power is lost. The "measured" caption in frame 6 says each check is compared only with its own first payment.
